correctness.rationale: For any higher/lower energy product words, the exact logarithmic-population difference is \(\big[(u+v)d+(u-v)\Delta\ell\big]/2\); energy parity constrains Delta_ell. The resulting global inequality is sufficient for every word pair, and a pair of adjacent-energy extremal words proves necessity. Boundary equality, weak population ordering, u=v and even-copy padding are explicitly handled. The independent exact integer verifier covers 1430 finite instances as a consistency check, not as universal proof.

value.rationale: The exact minimal number of copies needed to extract cyclic work is a natural operational invariant, previously approached with upper bounds or examples. The result classifies a full continuous simplex, includes equality thresholds and a physically meaningful parity plateau, and constructs the first strict work witness. This is a nontrivial complete finite-copy result, not an isolated arithmetic example or a cosmetic improvement.
